Services and Treatment Options

Your diagnosis, symptoms, and treatment history guide your care. We offer a range of personalized pain management services, including nonsurgical, regenerative, and minimally invasive treatment options for eligible patients.

Personalized Pain Management

Individualized treatment plans designed around your condition, daily challenges, and goals for improved function and quality of life.

Platelet-Rich Plasma (PRP)

This procedure uses a concentrated preparation of platelets from your own blood, with a medical evaluation to assess suitability for selected knee, neck, back, shoulder, and hip conditions.

Stem Cell Therapy (Cell Rejuvenation)

Discuss cell-based procedures for knee, neck, back, shoulder, and hip concerns with your physician. A thorough evaluation and discussion of the evidence, risks, and alternatives help you make an informed decision.

Image-Guided Joint and Spine Injections

Targeted procedures for the knees, shoulders, hips, and spine, using advanced imaging to help guide precise treatment placement.

Nerve Blocks

Targeted procedures that may help identify the source of pain or provide relief for certain nerve-related conditions.

Epidural Steroid Injections

Minimally invasive injections that may help manage inflammation and pain associated with certain spine-related conditions.

Radiofrequency Ablation/Rhizotomy

Minimally invasive procedures that target specific nerves to help reduce certain types of chronic pain affecting the spine and joints.

Spinal Cord Stimulation

An advanced treatment option for selected patients experiencing persistent pain, using mild electrical impulses to modify pain signals.

Anesthesia Available

Your comfort matters. Anesthesia is available for appropriate procedures, based on your medical history, individual needs, and your care team’s assessment.

Why Patients Choose ISPM for Pain Management

Care Led by an Experienced Specialist

Under the leadership of Okezie N. Okezie, MD, FAAPMR, ISPM provides specialized pain management backed by board certifications in Pain Medicine and Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation, as well as fellowship training in interventional pain management. Our approach combines medical expertise with individualized attention to help patients explore treatment options that address their unique needs.

A Plan Built Around Your Needs

We understand that every patient’s experience with pain is different. That’s why we develop individualized care plans based on your symptoms, medical history, and treatment goals rather than taking a one-size-fits-all approach.

Image-Guided Treatment Options

When appropriate, our team uses advanced imaging technology to guide interventional procedures, supporting precise treatment delivery to targeted areas.

A Focus on Mobility and Everyday Function

Our approach goes beyond addressing pain alone. We consider how your symptoms affect your ability to work, move comfortably, and participate in daily activities, with treatment recommendations focused on improving function and quality of life.

Care Close to Home

With locations in Humble and Baytown, ISPM provides accessible pain management services for patients throughout the Greater Houston area.
